dz: 在第九次十字军东征期间出行期间,爱德华王子在英格兰的亨利三世去世后成为了英格兰国王,但他在将近两年的时间里不会回到英格兰来登上王位.
de: While travelling during the Ninth Crusade, Prince Edward becomes King of England upon Henry III of England's death, but he will not return to England for nearly two years to assume the throne.
